state.rule: Removal from the effective administrator set must leave another active tenant administrator. A withdrawal (suspend, deprovision, administrators-team removal) of the last available administrator is refused with a conflict and appends no guard fact.
state.scenario: Two available administrators A and B. A deprovisions B and the withdrawal is accepted (pending, B no longer available). B then tries to deprovision A. The guard refuses with the shared last-administrator conflict; the guard stream has the same fact count as before; available count is 1.
state.decision: Keep TenantManagerGuard as one tenant singleton deciding withdrawals and episode admission together.

asserts_invariant.instructions: Does the described scenario's outcome demonstrate the stated invariant for deprovisioning?

criteria.true: The refusal of the last available administrator's deprovisioning with no new fact shows the invariant.
criteria.false: The scenario does not exercise the invariant.

keep_together.instructions: Is keeping pending withdrawals and available contributors under one guard consistent with the rule?

criteria.true: Two concurrent withdrawals must be decided against the same state to preserve one active administrator.
criteria.false: The rule can be enforced by independently governed owners.
